[*Open during the summer only. (t)The day schools at Fort William closed from June 30, 1907. (tt)Reopened January
27, 1908, having been closed since December 31, 1906. (||)Indian children attend white school. (pp)Reopened January
2, 1908, having been closed for several years. (ss)Indian children attend white school. Department pays 50 cents (per
cap.) per month on average attendance. **Reopened January 2, 1908, having been closed since December 31, 1904.]
